title: ANZ completes major cloud data transformation, strengthening data foundations to improve customer experiences
headline: ANZ completes major cloud data migration using AI-assisted engineering
summary: ANZ has migrated its Enterprise Big Data platform to AWS in six months using AI-assisted engineering and agentic AI. The project moved 1.7 petabytes of data supporting payments, business banking and customer remediation. The bank used Amazon Bedrock-powered tools to analyse, convert, test, and optimise workloads, reducing migration effort by 35 per cent.
why_it_matters: The deployment demonstrates how a major Australian financial institution is using agentic AI and AI-assisted engineering to accelerate complex legacy data migrations while maintaining security and resilience controls.

quotes.text: ANZ has completed the migration of one of its largest data platforms to Amazon Web Services (AWS), establishing a modern, scalable foundation to support the bank's growing use of data, analytics and AI.
The transformation moved 1.7 petabytes of data, equivalent to more than 340 million smartphone photos, across 300 million files, 142,000 tables, 4,500 automated data workflows and 4,000 views.
It also demonstrates how AI-assisted engineering can accelerate complex delivery while maintaining a disciplined focus on security, resilience and quality.

classification.significance_reason: A significant production-scale deployment of agentic AI and AI-assisted engineering for core banking infrastructure by a major Australian bank.
